RunAtLogin.title: Run at Login
RunAtLogin.description: Start the packaged Looper menu bar in each graphical login session. Defaults to enabled.

SkipSetupAssistant.title: Skip Setup Assistant
SkipSetupAssistant.description: Suppress first-open setup for each user. Settings can still open the assistant manually.

RunAppContentSets.title: Run Scope
RunAppContentSets.description: Apps omitted from this setting are out of scope.

GarageBand.title: GarageBand
GarageBand.description: All follows the catalogue, Essential follows the essential set, and None disables the app.

Logic Pro.title: Logic Pro
Logic Pro.description: All follows the catalogue, Essential follows the essential set, and None disables the app.

AppPackageOverrides.title: Per-app Package Overrides
AppPackageOverrides.description: Use comma-separated package IDs or installer receipt IDs.

Skip.title: Skip
Skip.description: Packages to exclude for this app. Skip takes precedence over Only.

Only.title: Only Install
Only.description: When populated, install only these packages for this app. New IDs are excluded automatically. None still disables the app.

Skip.title: Skip
Skip.description: Packages to exclude for this app. Skip takes precedence over Only.

Only.title: Only Install
Only.description: When populated, install only these packages for this app. New IDs are excluded automatically. None still disables the app.

ExcludedPackageIDs.title: Global Package Exclusions
ExcludedPackageIDs.description: Comma-separated package or receipt IDs excluded for every app.

PackagePriorities.title: Package Priorities
PackagePriorities.description: Map package or receipt IDs to integer priorities. Higher values install first. Use a custom plist for arbitrary keys if Jamf does not render this editor.

ManagedPreloadEnabled.title: Preload managed sound library
ManagedPreloadEnabled.description: Install the managed RunAppContentSets scope at deployment, at boot and hourly. Runs as a device service and honors quiet hours.

ScheduledInstallEnabled.title: Allow Jamf Scheduled Installs
ScheduledInstallEnabled.description: Permits looper install --scheduled. Set the cadence in the Jamf policy.

ScheduleQuietHours.title: Scheduled Install Quiet Hours
ScheduleQuietHours.description: Optional local hours as start-end, in 24-hour time. For example, 8-16 blocks starts from 8 AM until 4 PM.

HelperRunMode.title: Helper Run Mode
HelperRunMode.description: Select sequential or staged helper mode.
